planets.name: K2-25 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-25 with a 3.48-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: K2-25 b was found in 2015 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-25. Its orbit and size follow Stefansson et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
